verdict.rationale: GitBook's block-based visual editor lets teammates edit content without git (gitbook-docs-3), with team collaboration invites (gitbook-docs-8) and change requests (gitbook-docs-29) that flow through GitHub/GitLab sync (gitbook-docs-4, gitbook-docs-27) to keep git as the source of truth. Community feedback corroborates the editor quality ('web-based book editor is phenomenal' — gitbook-comm-5) and version control integration (gitbook-comm-3). Missing for 10: explicit hands-on evidence from a non-technical persona using the editor, and detail on how conflicts between visual edits and git commits are resolved.
